subject: PO ticketing, ledger harmonize and spendcap playbook
messages:
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@stratussys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@stratussys.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting PO number and spend-cap confirmation for onboarding

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. We're excited to get Stratus Systems set up. To move forward with procurement on our side we need: a provisional PO number (or the steps to request one), confirmation of the spend cap for initial phase-1 usage, and the canonical ledger line items so our finance team can map invoices.

Attached is the preliminary line-item breakdown from our PM (Stratus_LineItems_v1.xlsx). A couple items are bundled currently; happy to split them if Redwood needs explicit SKU-level lines.

Could you confirm the expected timeline for PO issuance and whether there are any required onboarding forms? If helpful, I can loop in our procurement contact (contracts@stratussys.com).

Thanks,
Samantha Ruiz
Head of Partnerships
Stratus Systems

Attachment: Stratus_LineItems_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 14KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@stratussys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting PO number and spend-cap confirmation for onboarding

Samantha —

Great to meet you earlier. Quick notes and next steps so we can avoid back-and-forths: 

- Spend cap: for new vendor onboarding we typically set a provisional spend cap for the first billing period. For phase 1 (pilot) we can start at $25,000 USD and then bump after successful integration. If Stratus needs a lower/higher threshold please specify.
- Provisional PO: procurement can issue a provisional PO number while we complete vendor validation. We need: vendor legal name, billing address, W-9 (or equivalent), and the finalized line-item CSV.
- Line items: It helps if you split the three bundled items into discrete SKUs (compute, storage, professional services). Monica, can you pick up and generate a provisional PO number once Samantha confirms the final CSV?

Samantha — please fill the attached vendor-onboard form (I attached the template) and return with the spreadsheet. I'll cc procurement to expedite.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_onboard_template.docx (form, 22KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@stratussys.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting PO number and spend-cap confirmation for onboarding

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the spreadsheet and Karthik for the context. A few procurement clarifications before I issue the provisional PO: 

1) Can you produce the line items in CSV with these headers: description, sku_code (if you have it), qty, unit_price, unit_currency, ext_notes. The attached file (provisional_po_78921.csv) is our preferred layout — we can map fields to your sheet if you return that version.
2) Legal/billing: Please send Stratus Systems legal name exactly as on invoices and a billing address. We also need a copy of the tax doc (W-9) or VAT equivalent for vendor validation.
3) Spend cap: Per Karthik's note, we're okay to start at $25,000 for pilot. If you need a $10k pilot to satisfy internal approvals, say so and we can lower it.
4) Line-item corrections: I noticed line 3 (bundled services) has an ambiguous qty. Please confirm whether that is 1x managed-service-month or 12x monthly seats.

If you can reply with the CSV and docs by EOD Friday Jul 16 I'll issue a provisional PO number (format: P-78921-XXXX) and send the provisional ledger feed so your AR team can begin mapping.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: provisional_po_78921.csv (template, 4KB)

From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@stratussys.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@stratussys.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting PO number and spend-cap confirmation for onboarding

Monica / Karthik —

Thanks — attached is the updated CSV with SKU splits and corrected quantities. We split the bundled item into two SKUs (managed-services-monthly and onboarding-fee). The qty for managed services is 12 (monthly seats). Also attached: signed W-9 and a PDF of our latest SOW (Stratus_SOW_v2.pdf).

We also completed the vendor-onboard form you sent, and have our contracts team ready to DocuSign the Master Services Agreement. Link to DocuSign is below.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/AbCdEfGh12345
Drive (supporting docs): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-stratus-onboard

Attachment list: Stratus_LineItems_v1.xlsx, Stratus_SOW_v2.pdf, Stratus_LineItems_v2.csv, W-9_Stratus.pdf

—Samantha

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@stratussys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Provisional PO issued: P-78921-0001 and ledger mapping

Samantha —

Per your updated CSV and supporting docs, procurement has created a provisional PO number: P-78921-0001. This provisional PO carries a pilot spend cap of $25,000 USD and will be valid for 60 days while onboarding completes. 

Attached is the provisional_po_78921.csv (format we pushed into ledger) — please confirm your AR team can map to these ledger fields. Notes: 
- We normalized the bundled item into two ledger lines (SKU: STR-MGMT-MO, STR-ONB-FEE). Unit quantities reflect 12x monthly for STR-MGMT-MO. 
- If Stratus needs invoices split differently (e.g., monthly invoice for managed services + one-time onboarding fee) let us know and we'll accept both invoice types under the PO.
- As reminder, final PO (for committed spend / contract) will be issued once legal countersigns the MSA and billing validation completes.

Marissa, Priyom — flagging for legal/finance to watch for final sign and to convert provisional PO to full PO once doc is executed.

Samantha — can you confirm by EOD Thu Jul 22 that your AR team can ingest the ledger fields? Once confirmed we'll flip the ledger feed to your ERP test endpoint.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Manager

Attachment: provisional_po_78921.csv (generated, 2KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@stratussys.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional PO issued: P-78921-0001 and ledger mapping — confirmed

Samantha —

Confirmed on our side: procurement issued P-78921-0001 and finance validated the ledger mapping. AR can accept monthly managed-service invoices and a one-time onboarding invoice under the same PO. We will monitor consumption against the $25k spend cap and notify you if we need to pause ingestion or change routing.

A couple closing items to speed final PO conversion: 
- Legal to confirm MSA executed by both parties (Priyom, any ETA?)
- Finance to confirm final billing address on Stratus W-9 (Samantha, we received W-9 but the billing address doesn't match the CSV; small mismatch)

Samantha — once you confirm billing address match and the AR mapping, I'll mark this thread as ready for final PO issuance and transition to vendor success. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
